**About the Role**

We are seeking a results-driven Assistant Mobilization Manager to join our operations team in Dubai. In this role, you will drive the end-to-end mobilization and onboarding of Owners Association (OA) and property management accounts, ensuring new communities and developments are transitioned smoothly into operational readiness. You will work closely with developers, clients, internal departments, contractors, and service providers to coordinate procurement, handover, vendor onboarding, documentation, and budget preparation. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously while maintaining rigorous follow-through on every action item.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Mobilization & Onboarding**

* Plan, coordinate, and drive the mobilization and onboarding of new OA/PM accounts and communities, from award through to full operational readiness.
* Manage property handover and onboarding requirements, including documentation collection, compliance checks, and developer/client coordination.
* Develop and maintain detailed onboarding trackers, action plans, milestones, and deadlines; ensure actions are closed out rather than simply reported.
* Identify dependencies and critical-path items — what must happen first, what can run in parallel, and where early action is required to avoid delays.

**Procurement, Tendering & Vendor Management**

* Support the full procurement cycle: gathering and consolidating requirements, obtaining and comparing quotations, coordinating tenders, following the approval workflow, and tracking delivery.
* Coordinate vendor and service-provider onboarding, including contracts, insurance, and compliance documentation.
* Liaise with contractors and service providers on scope, schedules, and performance during the mobilization phase.

**Budgeting, Contracts & Documentation**

* Assist in preparing and reviewing mobilizing projects budgets, cost estimates, and contract documentation.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date project files, records, and operational documentation in line with company and regulatory requirements.

**Coordination, Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate across internal departments, developers/clients, contractors, and service providers to keep mobilization on track.
* Conduct persistent follow-up on pending items and escalate clearly and promptly when deadlines or dependencies are at risk.
* Organize and lead mobilization meetings, prepare agendas, record minutes, and track action items to closure.
* Prepare concise, regular progress reports and updates for management.
* Proactively identify gaps, chase missing information, propose practical alternatives, and keep onboarding progressing rather than waiting passively.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience:**

Around 3–5 years of relevant UAE experience, preferably within Owners Association (OA), Property Management (PM), Community Management, or related real-estate operations, with solid exposure to the Dubai market.

**Operational Knowledge**

* Good working knowledge of OA/PM operations, including procurement and tendering, vendor/service-provider coordination, budgeting, contracts, property handover/onboarding requirements, documentation, and general operational processes.
* Understanding of the procurement cycle — preparing/collecting requirements, obtaining and comparing quotations, coordinating tenders, following approvals, vendor onboarding, and tracking delivery.

**Project Management & Planning**

* Strong ability to organize and drive multiple onboarding projects simultaneously, maintain trackers and action plans, establish priorities and deadlines, and ensure actions are closed rather than simply reported.
* Able to understand dependencies — what needs to happen first, what can happen in parallel, what could delay operational readiness, and where early action is required.

**Coordination & Follow-Up**

* Strong at coordinating across internal departments, developers/clients, contractors, and service providers, with persistent follow-up and clear escalation when deadlines or dependencies are at risk.

**Communication & Problem-Solving**

* Strong written and verbal English; professional stakeholder communication, meeting coordination, minutes/action tracking, and concise reporting to management.
* Able to identify gaps, chase missing information, propose practical alternatives, and keep onboarding progressing rather than waiting passively for everything to be provided.

**Tools & Technical Skills**

* Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills; comfortable working with trackers, reports, budgets, and project documentation.
* Experience with property-management systems is an advantage.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Have)**

* RERA / Dubai real-estate regulatory knowledge or relevant certification.
* Hands-on experience with community mobilization from developer handover to operational go-live.
* Familiarity with OA budgeting and service-charge cycles.
* Arabic language skills are a plus.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a professional and customer-oriented Automotive Service Advisor to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for welcoming customers, receiving vehicles for service and repair, understanding customer concerns, coordinating with the technical team, preparing repair estimates, and ensuring a smooth customer experience from vehicle reception to final delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Welcome customers and professionally handle vehicle reception and check-in procedures.

- Listen to customer concerns, understand vehicle issues, and accurately record customer complaints.

- Conduct initial vehicle inspections and document the vehicle's condition upon arrival.

- Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and service-related concerns professionally.

- Maintain accurate customer records, job cards, service history, and repair documentation.

- Follow up with customers after vehicle delivery to ensure satisfaction.

Requirements and Qualifications

- Previous experience as an Automotive Service Advisor or in a similar position.

- Good knowledge of vehicle maintenance, mechanical repairs, and automotive systems.

- Experience in vehicle reception, inspection, and repair estimate preparation.

- Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers.

- Strong customer service and relationship management skills.

- Good organizational and multitasking abilities.

- Ability to coordinate effectively with workshop technicians.

- Good computer skills and experience with workshop management systems.

- Valid UAE driving license is preferred.

- Fluency in English is required; Arabic or Russian language skills are an advantage.

- Customer service and communication.

- Vehicle inspection and reception.

- Repair estimation and quotation preparation.

- Test driving and vehicle condition assessment.

- Workshop coordination and job management.

- Problem-solving and complaint handling.

- Time management and attention to detail.

- Customer relationship management.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

- Full-time employment.

- Professional working environment.

- Opportunities for career growth and development.

Dubai, UAE

  
  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Lead Tunnel Geotechnical Engineer** to join our team! In this role you will take technical ownership of the **geotechnical and tunnelling engineering** of the Airport Express Line and other high-profile rail, bridge and marine programmes — leading the design of **large-diameter TBM tunnels, mined crossover caverns and deep station excavations**, setting the ground investigation strategy that underpins them, and playing your part in the development of the City's infrastructure for the 21st Century.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

  
  

***Tunnel and Geotechnical Design Leadership:***

* Leading the geotechnical design of large-diameter (D > 10 m) TBM tunnels, including the TBM crossover caverns at rail junctions — ground treatment and pre-support, temporary and permanent support design, and excavation sequencing (SEM/NATM) of cavern and enlargement works.
* Leading deep excavation (> 30 m) methodology studies for stations, shafts and cross-passages — comparison and selection of retention systems (diaphragm wall, secant pile, top-down), base stability, dewatering and groundwater control, and the resulting construction methodology.
* Directing building and utility damage assessment for third-party structures adjacent to the alignment — volume loss and settlement prediction, Stage 1 to Stage 3 damage risk assessment, protective and mitigation measures, and instrumentation & monitoring with trigger levels and response plans.
* Predicting advance and production rates for large-diameter TBM drives, and forecasting cutter intervention frequency and location — including hyperbaric versus atmospheric intervention strategy, ground treatment at intervention points, and the effect of abrasivity, mixed-face and boulder conditions on the programme.
Owning the numerical modelling strategy (2D/3D finite element and finite difference — PLAXIS, FLAC/FLAC3D, MIDAS GTS or equivalent), soil-structure interaction, groundwater and seismic assessment, and technically reviewing the team's analyses.  

***Ground Investigation and Geotechnical Reporting:***

* Collecting, reviewing and interpreting existing and historical ground investigation data from adjacent and previous projects, and producing the project Geotechnical Interpretative Report (GIR), the geotechnical design parameters and, where required, the Geotechnical Baseline Report (GBR).
* Defining the ground investigation requirements for new projects — scope, technical specification, borehole layout and depths, in-situ and advanced laboratory testing schedules and geophysical surveys — and preparing the associated tender documents and technical evaluation.
* Managing the ground investigation programme from procurement to close-out: supervision of the GI contractor, factual report review, schedule and budget control, and timely integration of the results into the design.
  

  

***TBM Operations and Constructability:***

* Carrying out and documenting TBM optioning studies — machine type (EPB / slurry / variable density / hybrid), diameter, cutterhead and cutting tool configuration, back-up arrangement and segmental lining — with a clear and auditable basis of selection.
* Developing the TBM procurement and manufacturing plan (technical specification, manufacturing and factory acceptance programme, delivery and assembly schedule) together with the segment casting yard and site establishment plan.
* Preparing and documenting tunnelling logistics plans — launch and reception shafts, muck haulage and disposal, slurry treatment and separation plant, segment supply, annulus grouting, ventilation, power and water supply — and issuing them as method statements, technical notes and design reports.
  

  

***Team, Resource and Sub-Consultant Management:***

* Managing and directing the work of the existing geotechnical and tunnelling staff — workload planning, task allocation, technical direction, quality checking prior to submission, and mentoring.
* Supporting the Director and Technical Director in strengthening the team — identifying resource gaps, defining roles, interviewing and recruiting new staff.
* Selecting, scoping and contracting specialist sub-consultants and third-party service providers (ground investigation contractors, numerical analysis specialists, instrumentation and monitoring providers), and managing their technical and commercial delivery.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil or Geotechnical Engineering; an MSc or PhD in Geotechnical or Tunnelling Engineering is strongly preferred.
* Minimum 20 years' relevant post-graduate work experience in geotechnical and tunnel engineering, of which at least 3 years must be on large-diameter TBM rail or metro tunnelling projects in a lead or principal role, is mandatory.
* Demonstrable, project-specific experience in each of the following: large-diameter (D > 10 m) TBM tunnel design; mined crossover cavern and junction design; deep (> 30 m) excavation and shaft design; third-party building damage assessment; and TBM production rate and cutter intervention prediction.
* Proven authorship of Geotechnical Interpretative Reports (GIR) and ground investigation specifications, and hands-on management of GI campaigns from scoping through to design integration.
* A recognised technical authority in tunnelling geotechnics — the depth of specialisation typically developed within a dedicated tunnelling and geotechnical consultancy, rather than a generalist civil engineering background.

* Advanced user of geotechnical numerical analysis software (PLAXIS 2D/3D, FLAC/FLAC3D, MIDAS GTS or equivalent).
* Prior experience providing guidance and leadership to junior engineers and managing sub-consultants.
* Strong communication skills, written and oral, in English.
* Dedication to technical excellence, innovation, and high-quality delivery.

  
  

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Previous experience in the UAE and GCC is an advantage; RTA, Dubai Metro, Etihad Rail or equivalent regional rail experience is a distinct advantage.
* Experience gained with a specialist tunnelling / geotechnical consultancy on major metro, high-speed rail or road tunnel programmes.

This is a working manager role: roughly 70–80% technical execution and standard-setting, and 20–30% people and delivery leadership. It is a build role — you set the technical bar by doing, then make that excellence repeatable so it outlives any one person.
  
  
Your domain sits alongside other IT engineering domains, and your success depends as much on clean collaboration across those boundaries as on the depth of your own work. You will cultivate strong vendor relationships and drive strategic partnerships that enhance application functionality and support — a single quote is a starting point, not a decision.
  
  
Scope boundary: This role owns corporate and employee-facing IT (the digital workplace), including identity and endpoint end-to-end, which adjacent IT teams consume. Where core platforms are provided centrally by Delivery Hero, this role owns the local instances and acts as talabat's engineering interface to those central teams.

Endpoint & Device Management

Incident Response & Reliability
  
  
Own incident response and the on-call rotation for your domain. Act as escalation point during peak and out-of-hours periods, run proactive incident communication, and drive root-cause resolution rather than recurring workarounds. Role Summary

We are a Dubai-based group of technology and media ventures and a direct partner of BytePlus (the enterprise arm of ByteDance). Through this partnership we distribute BytePlus AI model APIs — including the Seedance video models and other generative AI services — to businesses in the UAE and the region.

We are looking for a technical person who can run this distribution business day to day: manage the BytePlus partner and API panels, onboard and support our customers, and understand the business well enough to grow it. This is a hybrid role — half engineer, half account manager. You must be able to write code, read API docs and debug an integration, and you must also be able to sit with a customer, understand what they need and keep them happy and paying.

Key Responsibilities1. BytePlus panels and API operations

* Work daily with the BytePlus partner / distribution console and model API platform (e.g. ModelArk).
* Create and manage customer accounts, sub-accounts, API keys, quotas, rate limits and access to models.
* Monitor usage, consumption and spend per customer; catch abnormal usage or misuse early.
* Handle top-ups, credits, pricing tiers and usage reports in line with our agreement with BytePlus.
* Be our main technical contact with the BytePlus partner team: raise tickets, escalate issues, follow new model releases and changes to pricing or terms.

2. Customer onboarding and technical support

* Onboard new customers: account setup, API keys, first successful call, and getting them to production.
* Help customers integrate the APIs into their products: explain endpoints, authentication, parameters, async jobs and webhooks, error codes and limits.
* Write sample code, quick-start guides and simple integration examples (Python and/or JavaScript).
* Troubleshoot integration problems: read logs, reproduce errors, find whether the issue is on the customer side, our side or BytePlus's side.
* Run short technical demos and proof-of-concepts for prospects.

3. Account management

* Own a portfolio of customer accounts: regular check-ins, usage reviews and renewals.
* Understand each customer's use case and recommend the right models, settings and plans.
* Spot upsell opportunities (more volume, new models, higher tiers) and early signs of churn.
* Keep a clean CRM record of every account: contacts, contracts, usage, issues and next steps.

4. Business understanding and reporting

* Understand how our distribution business makes money: wholesale cost, resale price, margin, volume commitments and payment terms.
* Prepare a monthly report: usage per customer, revenue, margin, top issues and growth opportunities.
* Give input on pricing, packaging and which customer segments to target.
* Follow the AI model API market (competitors, pricing, new models) and share what matters.

5. Internal tooling and automation

* Build small internal tools and scripts: usage dashboards, billing reconciliation, alerts, customer reports.
* Automate repetitive panel and reporting work using the available APIs.
* Keep internal documentation and runbooks up to date.

RequirementsMust have

* 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: solutions engineer, technical account manager, developer relations, API support or similar — or a developer who has moved into a customer-facing role.
* Solid programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs: authentication, JSON, async jobs, webhooks, rate limits, error handling.
* Experience working with a cloud or API provider console (e.g. BytePlus, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, OpenAI or similar).
* Practical understanding of generative AI: LLMs, image and video generation models, prompts, tokens and usage-based pricing.
* Good business sense: you understand margins, usage-based billing and customer value.
* Excellent spoken and written English; able to explain technical things in plain words.
* Organised and reliable with follow-up.

Nice to have

* Direct experience with BytePlus, Volcano Engine or other ByteDance cloud products.
* Experience at a cloud reseller, distributor or managed-service partner.
* Arabic, Russian, Turkish, Chinese (Mandarin)
* Basic SQL and experience building dashboards.
* Knowledge of the UAE / GCC tech market.

Personal Qualities

* Comfortable switching between code and customer conversations in the same day.
* Proactive and owner-minded: you treat the accounts as your own business.
* Honest about problems; you escalate early instead of hiding issues.
* Fast learner who keeps up with a market that changes every month.
* Calm and patient with customers who are less technical.

Success Measures (first 6–12 months)

* All customer accounts set up, documented and monitored on the BytePlus panels.
* New customers reach their first production API call quickly and with little help from the founder.
* Clear monthly reporting on usage, revenue and margin.
* Growth in active customers and monthly API usage.
* Low churn and fast response to customer issues.

The Lead Imaging Consultant is responsible for providing technical leadership, application governance, implementation oversight, optimization, and operational support for enterprise clinical imaging systems across American Hospital Dubai. **Position Responsibility:**

Imaging Systems Leadership and Governance

* Leads the technical administration, configuration, integration, maintenance, and optimization of PACS, RIS, VNA, enterprise viewers, image exchange platforms, voice recognition solutions, advanced visualization tools, and other clinical imaging applications.
* Establishes imaging system standards, operating procedures, governance controls, service expectations, and technology roadmaps in alignment with clinical priorities, enterprise architecture, and organizational strategy.

* Coordinates the imaging applications support function, provide technical direction to analysts and vendors, and ensure issues are appropriately prioritized, investigated, escalated, and resolved.

Clinical Workflow and Systems Optimization

* Analyzes end-to-end imaging workflows from order entry and patient scheduling through modality acquisition, image interpretation, reporting, distribution, archiving, and clinical review.
* Collaborates with radiologists, cardiologists, technologists, nurses, physicians, and operational leaders to translate clinical requirements into safe, standardized, and efficient system workflows.
* Leads optimization initiatives addressing modality worklists, patient and study reconciliation, hanging protocols, report distribution, critical-results communication, image availability, turnaround time, and diagnostic user experience.
* Evaluate system enhancement requests, identify workflow risks and dependencies, and recommend solutions that improve patient safety, clinical productivity, service quality, and operational performance.

Integration and Interoperability

* Oversees DICOM, HL7, FHIR, IHE, and API-based integration between imaging platforms, modalities, the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), clinical systems, reporting solutions, patient portals, and external health information exchanges.

* Support secure exchange of imaging records with external providers and regulatory platforms, including applicable NABIDH integration and organizational interoperability requirements.

* Maintains controlled change-management processes and ensure all configuration changes, releases, interfaces, and system enhancements are appropriately reviewed, approved, documented, tested, and communicated.

Service Reliability and Technical Support

* Monitors system availability, interface performance, storage capacity, image-routing queues, application performance, database health, and service trends to maintain reliable 24/7 imaging operations.
* Leads investigation and resolution of complex incidents involving missing images, mismatched studies, patient identity errors, failed interfaces, modality connectivity, reporting interruptions, archive retrieval, and application performance.
* Coordinates with infrastructure, database, networking, cybersecurity, Biomedical Engineering, vendors, and clinical teams during critical incidents, planned maintenance, downtime, and system recovery.
* Maintains support escalation procedures, knowledge resources, service documentation, and on-call readiness to minimize disruption to diagnostic and clinical services.

Data Security, Compliance and Business Continuity

* Collaborates with Information Security to manage access controls, privileged accounts, audit logs, vulnerability remediation, secure image exchange, encryption, third-party access, and cybersecurity risks affecting connected imaging systems and modalities.
* Develops, tests, and maintains imaging-system business continuity, disaster recovery, downtime, backup, restoration, and high-availability procedures in coordination with infrastructure and clinical stakeholders.
* Supports accreditation surveys, regulatory inspections, internal audits, risk assessments, and corrective action plans related to clinical imaging technology, information management, and patient safety.

* Contributes to business cases, technical evaluations, requests for proposal, vendor selection, contract reviews, capital expenditure planning, licensing forecasts, storage projections, and total-cost-of-ownership assessments.
* Maintains an accurate inventory of imaging applications, interfaces, licenses, devices, software versions, dependencies, support agreements, certificates, and planned lifecycle replacements.
* Reviews vendor performance, recurring incidents, system utilization, licensing, maintenance costs, and improvement opportunities to support responsible technology investment.

Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement

* Approve voids, refunds and discounts within agreed limits.

* Enforce Dubai Municipality food safety rules and the cafe's HACCP-based food safety plan.
* Complete temperature logs for fridges, freezers and deliveries every shift.
* Make sure every food handler holds a valid Dubai Municipality occupational health card and required food safety training.
* Enforce cleaning schedules, allergen controls, labelling and FIFO stock rotation.
* Lead the team during Dubai Municipality inspections and close any findings by the deadline given.

* Set and model Escena's service standards on the floor.
* Handle complaints on the spot and log any that need follow-up.
* Monitor online reviews and delivery-app ratings with the Cafe Manager.
* Look after regulars and drive upselling of add-ons, pastries and retail items.

**Position:** Café Operations Manager  
**Department:** Operations  
**Reports To:** Café Owner / Management

Job Summary

The Café Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the café, ensuring efficient service, proper inventory control, effective supplier coordination, staff performance, and accurate financial reporting. The role focuses on maintaining operational efficiency, controlling costs, and ensuring high standards of customer service.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Daily Operations & POS Management**

* Oversee daily café operations and ensure smooth workflow.
* Manage and monitor the Point of Sale (POS) system.
* Verify daily sales, cash transactions, and payment reconciliations.
* Ensure accurate recording of sales, discounts, refunds, and expenses.
* Resolve operational issues and maintain service quality.

**2. Inventory & Stock Control**

* Maintain and regularly update inventory lists.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment.
* Conduct weekly stock counts and monthly inventory reconciliation.
* Track product usage, wastage, expiry dates, and stock discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and minimize unnecessary costs.

**3. Supplier Management & Procurement**

* Coordinate with suppliers for café products, beverages, pastries, packaging, and other supplies.
* Place purchase orders and follow up on deliveries.
* Verify delivered quantities, product quality, and invoices.
* Maintain supplier records, price lists, and payment schedules.
* Monitor supplier performance and negotiate pricing when required.
* Ensure consistent product availability and supply continuity.

**4. Staff Management & Mentoring**

* Supervise café employees and coordinate daily responsibilities.
* Prepare staff schedules and monitor attendance and punctuality.
* Train, mentor, and support employees to improve performance.
* Ensure compliance with workplace policies, hygiene standards, and customer service expectations.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and address staff concerns.
* Promote teamwork, accountability, and a positive working environment.

**5. Financial Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare daily sales summaries and cash reconciliation reports.
* Submit weekly operational reports covering sales, inventory, expenses, and staff performance.
* Monitor operating costs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Perform monthly financial close-out procedures, including sales reconciliation, supplier invoices, inventory valuation, and expense verification.
* Prepare monthly financial summaries for management review.
* Coordinate with accounting personnel to ensure accurate financial records.

**6. Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction**

* Maintain consistent standards of product presentation and service.
* Monitor customer feedback and resolve complaints professionally.
* Ensure cleanliness, equipment maintenance, and operational readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

Reporting Requirements

* **Daily:** POS reconciliation, sales verification, and operational monitoring.
* **Weekly:** Sales performance, inventory status, supplier updates, staff performance, and operational issues.
* **Monthly:** Financial close-out, expense summaries, inventory reconciliation, supplier payment tracking, and overall performance review.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Previous experience in café, retail, or hospitality operations management.
* Proficiency in POS systems and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong inventory control and supplier coordination skills.
* Basic accounting, budgeting, and financial reporting knowledge.
* Strong leadership, communication, and staff mentoring abilities.
* Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Sales performance and revenue growth.
* Inventory accuracy and wastage reduction.
* Supplier delivery reliability and cost control.
* Staff productivity and attendance.
* Accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting.
* Customer satisfaction and service quality.

**Scope of Position:** This role is focused on café operations, retail sales, staff supervision, supplier coordination, and financial administration. The café does not operate an in-house kitchen; therefore, food preparation, cooking, recipe development, and kitchen management are excluded from the position's responsibilities.

This version is suitable for a café such as Suhail Café, where products are sourced from external suppliers rather than prepared in an in-house kitchen. It can be used for recruitment, an employment contract attachment, or defining the manager's responsibilities and accountability.

Responsible to serve as the source of truth about passengers, who they are, what they value and where they struggle to ensure that design, investment and operational decisions across HIA are based on evidence. Own end-to-end Voice of Customer programme, from data collection and research through to insight generation and strategic dissemination, ensuring every major capex, technology, and service-design decision is backed by robust passenger evidence, reducing wasted spend and improving the return on every investment in the airport, to ensure HIA is a customer-centric airport.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategic**

* Define and evolve the VoC strategy across all HIA touchpoints (landside, airside, retail, lounge, transfer, arrivals), aligning measurement frameworks with MATAR's wider CX Strategy & Roadmap and commercial objectives, to ensure passenger insight remains central to long-term planning.
* Design and maintain passenger segmentation models, personas, and end-to-end journey maps (e.g., premium, family, PRM, transfer, O&D) so that CX initiatives, capital projects, and commercial offers are targeted to clearly defined passenger needs rather than assumptions.
* Develop and present executive-level insight packs (with clear "so-what" narratives and prioritised recommendations) for APC, the CX & Brand Committee, and project steering groups, to embed passenger evidence into investment cases and governance decisions.

**Operational**

* Establish an insight-led decision-making culture by implementing a policy requiring all major design, technology, and capex proposals to reference VoC data, reducing the volume of "unknown" or anecdotal decisions across the organization.
* Partner with Qatar Airways (QR), Qatar Duty Free (QDF), and Qatar Aviation Services (QAS) analytics teams to link passenger satisfaction insights with loyalty, dwell-time, and commercial-spend data, enabling a unified view of passenger value and behavior across the airport ecosystem.
* Benchmark HIA's VoC programme against global best practice (Skytrax, ACI ASQ, and leading hub airports) to identify emerging methodologies, technologies, and standards, ensuring HIA maintains its competitive edge in passenger experience measurement.
* Identify and prioritise passenger pain points and opportunity areas through root-cause analysis and trend monitoring and translate these into a prioritised improvement backlog that informs the CX Roadmap and annual business planning cycle.
* Champion data governance and ethical research standards across all VoC activities, ensuring compliance with Qatar data-protection regulations and international best practice for passenger privacy, consent, and data security.
* Own and operate the integrated VoC collection ecosystem - including CSAT/NPS surveys, SMS and QR code intercepts, digital feedback channels, social-media listening, and complaint/compliment analysis - to maximise coverage and response rates at every key passenger touchpoint.
* Commission and conduct targeted qualitative research (ethnographic studies, passenger interviews, journey shadowing, mystery shopping, and UX testing) to uncover deep behavioral insights that quantitative data alone cannot reveal.
* Manage closed-loop feedback processes by routing actionable alerts to relevant operational teams (e.g., facilities, operations, security), tracking resolution, and reporting back to passengers where appropriate, to demonstrate that feedback drives tangible change.
* Administer and optimize VoC technology platforms (e.g., survey tools, text/sentiment analytics, dashboards) to ensure data accuracy, system reliability, and integration with business-intelligence infrastructure.
* Coordinate fieldwork logistics for passenger intercept surveys, pop-up research, and observational studies across the terminal, working with airport operations and security to ensure research activities do not disrupt passenger flow or operational efficiency.
* Produce ad-hoc insight briefings and rapid-turnaround analyses in response to emerging issues (e.g., disruption events, new facility openings, seasonal peaks), equipping leadership with real-time passenger sentiment to guide immediate decisions.
* Manage external research vendors and agency relationships, including scope definition, procurement, quality assurance, and budget control, to ensure third-party deliverables meet HIA's standards for rigor and relevance.
* Build internal VoC capability by training and coaching cross-functional stakeholders (project managers, operational leads, commercial teams) on how to interpret and apply passenger insights in their day-to-day decision-making.
* Maintain a centralized insights repository that is accessible to authorized stakeholders, ensuring historical data, research reports, and persona documentation are well-organised, version-controlled, and easily retrievable.
* Perform other department duties related to his / her position as directed by the Head of the Department

* Experience in developing voice of the customer dashboards and presentations.

The Supervisor - Operations (CashMyCar) overseas the day-to-day ground operations of the CashMyCar inspection bays located within designated Woqod Gas Stations. · Analyze the prices of material, labor productivity and related equipment.

**Job Summary**

Lead the continuous monitoring, analysis and assurance of fire and life safety operational performance across Qiddiya City. The role converts alarms, impairments, incidents, inspections, maintenance and readiness data into actionable risk intelligence, ensuring emerging threats are identified, escalated and managed through the City Command Unit and accountable asset operators.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Establish the FLS operational monitoring framework, control standards, escalation matrix, dashboards and reporting cadence.
* Monitor fire alarms, supervisory signals, faults, impairments, isolations, fire-water availability and other material life-safety conditions received through CCU and approved platforms.

* Set data-quality, classification and record-retention requirements so that operational decisions are based on reliable evidence.
* Lead operational performance reviews with asset owners and operators, challenging overdue actions and escalating material risk.
* Support incident command with current asset, system, impairment and emergency-plan information.

* Develop KPIs for alarm handling, verification, turnout/interface, impairment duration, defect closure and readiness.
* Coordinate monitoring requirements for new assets, including signal mapping, naming conventions, priorities, integrations, testing and acceptance.
* Assure business continuity and contingency arrangements for loss of monitoring, communications or critical systems.
* Produce daily exception reports, weekly trend reviews and monthly executive assurance reports.
* Lead post-incident and post-alarm analysis and ensure corrective actions are tracked to verified closure.
* Coach monitoring analysts and duty personnel and support Saudization and competence assurance.

Key Internal Interactions

* CCU; City Operations FLS; Security; Facilities Management; Asset Management; HSE; Digital/ICT; Data and Analytics; venue and asset operators; Emergency Services.

Key External Interactions

* Saudi Civil Defense and emergency-service interfaces.
* Fire alarm monitoring providers, system integrators, maintainers, specialist vendors and independent assurance providers.

 **Requirements**

The Sr. Manager of EPM Platform is a people-leadership role accountable for the governance, change management, and controls posture of the organization's EPM platforms, leading a team of two EPM Administrators covering OneStream, the organization's new EPM platform, and Hyperion, the legacy platform. Acting as the primary point of accountability between the business, the EPM Administrators, and third-party MSO consultants, the Manager quarterbacks all incoming requests from intake through resolution — triaging priority and complexity, assigning the right resource, and ensuring work is delivered within a disciplined change management and controls framework. The role also owns the Hyperion transition: Hyperion will stop receiving operational updates after December 2026, though system access will continue beyond that date. This role establishes and enforces the protocols that protect the integrity, security, and auditability of the EPM environment, while ensuring the business experiences a single, well-managed front door for EPM platform needs.

**Key Accountabilities**

***Business Request Intake & Triage***

* Serve as the single point of accountability and “quarterback” for all OneStream-related requests coming in from the business.
* Triage incoming requests for priority, complexity, and risk, and determine the appropriate resourcing path — the EPM Administrators, third-party MSO consultants, or a combination of both.
* Engage directly with business stakeholders to clarify scope, gather requirements, set expectations, and provide status updates through to resolution.
* Act as the day-to-day relationship owner with third-party MSO consultants, directing their work, reviewing deliverables, and holding them accountable to timelines and quality standards.
* Reinforce EPM as the mandatory first point of contact for all OneStream requests, redirecting stakeholders who attempt to bypass the intake process.
* Escalate complex, cross-functional, or resourcing conflicts to the Sr. Director, Data & Analytics with clear recommendations.

***Change Management***

* Own and continuously improve the change management framework for the OneStream platform, covering configuration, security, integrations, and reporting/planning logic.
* Establish and enforce a formal change intake, approval, and sign-off process, including documentation standards and required approvals prior to promotion to production.
* Assess and document the business, technical, and risk impact of proposed changes before implementation.
* Maintain a complete, auditable change log/register for the OneStream environment.
* Plan and coordinate release and deployment schedules to minimize disruption during peak business cycles (month-end, quarter-end, budget, and forecast).

***Governance, Controls & Compliance***

* Design, implement, and enforce governance protocols and standard operating procedures for OneStream administration and system change.
* Define, monitor, and enforce security, access, and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with the EPM Administrators.
* Ensure OneStream administration and change activity meet internal controls, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead periodic reviews/audits of system configuration, user access, and change history, and remediate gaps.
* Own and maintain governance documentation, including policies, procedures, RACI, and control frameworks for the EPM environment.

***Platform & Vendor Oversight***

* Manage the ongoing relationship with third-party MSO consultants, directing their work and holding them accountable to timelines, deliverable quality, and scope.
* Oversee Testing/QA and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles for OneStream releases, ensuring they follow the established change management protocol.
* Ensure system and control documentation remains current and reflects the live-state configuration of the platform.

***People Leadership:***

* Directly manage the two EPM Administrators (OneStream and Hyperion), including workload planning, performance management, coaching, and professional development.
* Own the Hyperion end-of-life transition plan, coordinating accessibility and operational update cut-off ahead of the end-of-2026 sunset date with stakeholders.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop EPM Administrator talent, and foster teamwork and knowledge-sharing across the OneStream and Hyperion functions.

Department Leadership (as applicable)

* Own budgetary and financial oversight of third-party MSO consultant spend, including statements of work, invoice/effort accuracy, and OneStream licensing costs, in partnership with the Sr. Director, Data & Analytics.

**Qualifications**

***Education:***

* Post-secondary Diploma or University Degree in Computer Science, Accounting/Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
* OneStream certification (Administrator or Design) is strongly preferred.
* Accounting and financial knowledge is a strong asset, given the controls and compliance focus of the role.

***Experience:***

* 5-7+ years of experience in EPM/financial systems administration, IT governance, or systems delivery, including hands-on OneStream experience (Hyperion or comparable EPM platform experience considered).
* Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or enforcing change management processes for enterprise systems.
* Experience designing or enforcing IT governance, controls, or compliance protocols; SOX or internal audit experience is an asset.
* Experience triaging and managing incoming business requests, and translating business needs into scoped technical work.
* Experience managing third-party vendors, managed service providers, or consultants, including SOWs, deliverables, and performance accountability.
* Experience acting as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams; prior direct people-management experience, including performance management and coaching, is preferred.

***Skills & Abilities:***

* Strong understanding of change management practice and IT general controls (ITGCs) as applied to enterprise/financial systems, and working knowledge of OneStream functionality (consolidation, reporting, planning, security) sufficient to triage and validate technical requests without requiring deep hands-on administration.
* OneStream – Advanced; Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint – Advanced.
* Confident, credible stakeholder management with the ability to set expectations and manage competing priorities.
* Skilled at directing and holding external consultants/MSOs accountable to scope, timelines, and quality.

Sound judgment in assessing urgency, impact, and risk to sequence competing requests.

Primarily mental effort: sustained concentration and attention to detail when reviewing system configurations, change requests, and audit/control documentation; extended periods viewing a computer screen while validating OneStream/Hyperion data, coordinating releases, and managing competing priorities across the team and business stakeholders. **Introduction**

Women’s College Hospital (WCH) is seeking a dynamic, inspiring and visionary medical leader to lead the Department of Medicine and join the medical leadership team. The Department Head will advance innovative models of specialized ambulatory care and strengthen academic, interprofessional, and interorganizational collaboration to improve access, quality and health outcomes for women and gender-diverse people.

The Department Head will report to the Hospital President & CEO through the Vice President, Medical Affairs & System Transformation and Lead Medical Executive. The Department Head is responsible for aligning the Department of Medicine’s clinical, academic and research activities with the Hospital’s strategy, in partnership with the Clinical Director for Specialized Medicine programs. The Department Head works collaboratively with the Temerty Faculty of Medicine, the Toronto Academic Health Science Network (TAHSN), partner hospitals, and the Women’s College Hospital Foundation leadership team.

**The Department of Medicine**

The Department of Medicine at WCH advances the practice and science of medicine through holistic, innovative, and interprofessional approaches to complex health conditions and distinctive models of specialized ambulatory care. The Department advances care for conditions that disproportionately affect women and special populations, including through the specialized Dermatology, Menopause and After Cancer Treatment Transition Clinics.

The Department includes approximately 150 physician faculty members, including clinician teachers, educators, quality and innovation leaders, clinician investigators and clinician scientists. Its Specialized Medicine programs bring together nursing and health discipline professionals as well as clinical and academic administrative staff.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The Department Head will lead the clinical, academic and resource oversight of the WCH Department of Medicine. More specifically, the Department Head will:

* Provide visionary leadership and operational oversight of the Department to advance the Hospital’s strategic plan and delivery of high-quality, equitable and integrated specialized ambulatory care.
* Build and lead a team of dedicated medical professionals committed to excellence in clinical care, clinical innovation, and continuous quality improvement through physician engagement and collaborative leadership.
* Pursue excellence and represent WCH in academic medicine by advancing the educational, research and scholarly objectives of the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.
* Participate actively in WCH medical leadership.
* Grow existing and build new partnerships to advocate for and advance the goals of WCH beyond its walls.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The successful candidate will be:

* A Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of Canada or equivalent, eligible for medical licensure in Ontario, and for an academic appointment at the rank of Associate or Full Professor in the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.
* An individual with a demonstrated record of supporting others engaged in education, research and creative professional activity, in addition to having their own strong record of scholarship.
* A dynamic, compassionate and people-oriented leader, who demonstrates an empathetic, trusting, and responsive demeanor, with strong mentorship skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate strategically, engage physicians and lead change collaboratively and with accountability.
* An individual experienced in interprofessional models of care and committed to interprofessional education and patient care.
* A person with a strong commitment to social justice, equity and the health of women, gender-diverse people and equity-seeking communities, both locally and globally.
* A person with demonstrated fiscal management and resource stewardship skills, with an emphasis on linking quality outcomes with optimizing costs.

  

**EXPECTATIONS & TERM**

The successful candidate will be an outstanding academic leader and clinician, with proven excellence in managing complex health care environments. Candidates should have a deep commitment to scholarly enterprise, with experience in advancing peer-reviewed research and education in Medicine.

Salary for the role of Department Head will reflect an expected 2.5 days per week commitment, in addition to clinical compensation and other academic support based, in part, on fee-for-service billings and sessional fees.

The appointment is generally for a term of five years. After successful completion of the initial five-year appointment, a University/Hospital review will be conducted with potential reappointment for a final five-year term.

Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

The Public Cloud Operations Lead is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for supporting and leading Public Cloud operations and Site Reliability Engineering (CloudSRE).

The ideal candidate has a minimum of 4 years of relevant cloud, SRE, or infrastructure operations experience, previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent, and strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS. Experience with GCP and OCI is considered an asset.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical leadership to the CloudSRE team, remaining actively engaged in engineering, operational activities, and complex troubleshooting.

* Establish engineering standards and technical guardrails while mentoring engineers and strengthening the overall technical capability of the CloudSRE team.

Public Cloud Operations
  
  

* Provide hands-on administration, operations, and troubleshooting across Microsoft Azure and AWS, with experience in GCP and/or OCI considered an asset.

SRE & Observability

Permissions are the front door to everything a customer builds on AWS. When access is too broad, a single leaked credential or misconfigured policy can expose an entire business. When access is too narrow, builders get blocked, workarounds creep in, and security quietly erodes. Most customers are not IAM experts, and they should not have to be. Yet they are responsible for getting access exactly right across thousands of accounts, millions of resources, and policies that change every day.  
  
Now the problem is accelerating. AI agents are writing code, deploying infrastructure, and acting on builders' behalf at a pace no human review process can match. Every one of those agents needs permissions, and agents are remarkably good at finding and using permissions they were never meant to have. Excess access that sat unnoticed for years can now be discovered and exercised in minutes. If we make least privilege hard, customers will either slow down or open the doors wide. Neither is acceptable. The teams that make secure access the easy default will define how the next generation of software gets built safely.  
  
That is the mission of the AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Access Analyzer team. As a Software Development Manager, you will lead engineers who make IAM easier to use and more secure by default for millions of AWS customers. Your team will help customers see what access is possible across their whole AWS environment, cut back overly privileged access, troubleshoot access problems quickly, and preview the impact of security policy changes before they deploy them. You will also build tools that builders' AI agents use to generate better, least-privilege policies, so builders can move faster with agentic development while their agents get the access they need and nothing more.  
  
The work spans distributed systems at scale, automated reasoning, and customer-facing experiences, and the impact is direct: fewer security incidents, faster builders, and customers who trust that their access is right. You set a high engineering bar, drive operational excellence, and turn ambitious ideas into products customers rely on. If you want your work to make the cloud simpler and safer for everyone who builds on it, this is the role for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and execute product and architecture strategy for the Access Analyzer platform, working backwards from customers of every size to deliver deeper access insights across their entire AWS estate
* Build a culture of rapid prototyping: get creative, turn new ideas into working prototypes quickly, use them to earn stakeholder buy-in, and iterate on designs in days rather than months
* Own the team roadmap, plans, and deliverables, balancing customer features, platform investments, and operational improvements, and making clear tradeoffs as priorities evolve
* Proactively identify risks, mitigate them before they become roadblocks, and use sound judgment on when and how to escalate to senior leadership
* Own system reliability, scalability, and operational metrics for services that run at AWS scale

* Use AI tooling to improve engineering productivity, automate workflows, and raise the bar on operational efficiency

The AI & Technical Security Standards Manager leads the development, maintenance, and implementation of global cybersecurity standards covering artificial intelligence and other technically complex security domains. The role converts strategic, regulatory, risk, and engineering requirements into clear, practical, and measurable standards that can be adopted consistently across Deloitte Global.

This is a technically focused management role requiring sufficient depth to evaluate emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and hold credible discussions with security architects, engineers, data scientists, AI specialists, risk professionals, and other subject matter experts. The successful candidate will balance technical rigor with clear policy writing, and sound judgement.

The role works across Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to establish authoritative requirements, resolve complex standards questions, and support adoption. It also monitors developments in AI, cloud, software, infrastructure, and security engineering to ensure the standards portfolio remains relevant and forward-looking.

**Key Responsibilities**

***AI and technical security standards leadership***

* Own and manage the lifecycle (drafting, review, approval, publishing, maintenance) of Deloitte’s Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for AI and assigned technical security domains.
* Develop outcome-focused requirements that are technically credible, risk-based, and suitable for implementation across varied technology environments.
* Define security expectations for the design, development, acquisition, deployment, operation, and retirement of AI-enabled systems and supporting technology.
* Maintain new and revised standards, prioritized according to enterprise risk, regulatory change, technology adoption, and stakeholder need.
* Ensure AI-specific Deloitte Global Cybersecurity policies and standards are supported by clear guidance, control objectives, implementation considerations, and evidence expectations.

***Technical analysis and subject matter engagement***

* Lead detailed discussions with subject matter experts to understand technologies, threat scenarios, design constraints, and appropriate safeguards.
* Analyze architecture, engineering practices, threat intelligence, incidents, and control performance to identify where standards require clarification or enhancement.
* Translate complex technical concepts into concise requirements for technical and non-technical audiences without losing accuracy or intent.

**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------

***AI security and emerging technology***

* Enhance Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for generative AI, machine learning, autonomous and agentic systems, AI platforms, models, data, integrations, and third-party AI services.
* Assess threats including prompt injection, insecure model and tool integration, sensitive data exposure, model manipulation, supply-chain compromise, excessive agency, and inadequate human oversight.
* Apply relevant industry and regulatory frameworks, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and OWASP guidance, while adapting requirements to the organization’s risk context.

***Standards governance and assurance***

* Manage consultation, review, approval, publication, exception, and periodic review processes in accordance with the Global Cybersecurity Policy and Standards governance framework.
* Define measures for standards adoption and effectiveness, and provide clear reporting on implementation progress, material gaps, exceptions, and emerging risks.
* Support assurance and control teams in interpreting standards, evaluating evidence, and distinguishing material risk from implementation variance.

***Team leadership and talent development***

* Provide inclusive, visible, and accountable leadership to analysts on the team, setting clear direction and translating strategic priorities into achievable objectives.
* Build team capability through regular coaching, mentoring, constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and meaningful development opportunities, while fostering collaboration, technical curiosity, and high professional standards.
* Align internal resources, external vendors, and specialist expertise to business priorities; establish clear roles, governance, decision rights, service expectations, and SLAs; monitor capacity, program performance, delivery quality, risks, and dependencies.
* Recognize strong contributions; and promote ownership, resilience, and continuous improvement so that the team consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.

***Risk, regulatory, and industry alignment***

* Monitor changes in laws, regulations, contractual obligations, threat patterns, and recognized frameworks that affect AI and technical security requirements.
* Map standards to internal controls and external frameworks to support traceability, assurance, and regulatory response.
* Provide risk-based advice on deviations and exceptions, ensuring decisions, compensating controls, ownership, and remediation commitments are appropriately documented.

***Stakeholder leadership and enablement***

* Build productive relationships with stakeholders (Deloitte Firm SMEs), security and technology leaders, architects, engineers, product teams and risk owners.
* Chair working groups and facilitate constructive technical challenges to achieve clear, proportionate, and implementable requirements.
* Produce briefings and decision materials that help teams understand both the requirement and the risk it addresses.

* Own BC’s service and operational metrics (client volume, submission timeliness, claim acceptance and rejection rates, payment turnaround and cost to serve), so trends are spotted and acted on early.

**Job Description Summary**
The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is a senior leadership position within UBC Facilities. The Director provides strategic leadership for Facilities customer service function, customer service plan, business project management, business analysis, informatics, enterprise maintenance management system (EMMS), facilities information and inventory systems, change management, call centre management and clerical support services. This role develops strategic objectives, implements and monitors procedures and policies that enable Facilities to meet or exceed agreed customer service standards across the entire campus. In addition, this division provides all business units within Facilities the necessary business support both by providing the necessary analytics and analysis to ensure continuous improvements continue across the department. The Director is responsible for the development and sustainment of the Facilities Emergency Management Plan.
  
  
The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is the Facilities representative for customer engagement, business projects and initiatives, space inventory data, building and infrastructure records drawings and information, analytics, reporting, technology and continuous improvement initiatives. They partner with Information Technology (IT) and Safety and Risk Services (SRS) - Emergency Management, Project Management Office (PMO), Integrated Service Centre (ISC), Communications & Engagement for strategic alignment and resource allocation.
  
  
The Director leads a workforce of approximately 35 staff in professional and unionized positions. Prepares strategic and business plans and supports an annual Facilities budget of approximately $150M.
  
  
**Organizational Status**
This position reports directly to the Associate Vice-President, Facilities, and serves as a member of the Facilities Leadership team. Works closely with other Directors, Senior Managers, and Managers as well as other department‘s leadership teams. This position is the senior leader within Facilities responsible for implementing business transformational initiatives with the support of other divisions, monitoring operational progress through the analysis and reporting of information to guide evidence-based decision-making.

* Provides strategic leadership to the Facilities Leadership team through the Customer Services and Informatics division to execute a full range of department-wide services to meet targets and objectives of the Strategic Plan. This includes supporting and developing business plans; ensuring consistent and effective implementation; enhancing integration; standardizing services and business practices; maximizing efficiencies and cost savings.
* Responsible for business transformational projects through assessment, analysis, design and implementation; champions the implementation of change management initiatives, process and execution.

Clarke Construction is part of Clarke Group, a family-owned business with roots in Chatham-Kent going back more than 55 years. Our crews build underground utilities and fibre networks across Southwestern Ontario. We’re looking for an additional Health and Safety Manager who enjoys being on site, gets to know the people doing the work and follows through when something needs to change.

Field safety is your first responsibility. You’ll also have a hand in how we run the business. On a typical day, you might prepare a traffic control plan for a roadside fibre installation, review the setup and utility locates with the foreperson, then simplify a procedure based on what you saw in the field.

**What you’ll do**

* Visit active job sites regularly. Talk with operators, labourers and forepersons, check that safe work procedures are being followed and address concerns on the spot. Follow up to make sure corrections hold.
* **Create site-specific traffic control plans** for work on or beside public roads. Use Ontario Traffic Manual Book 7 – *Temporary Conditions* and applicable road authority requirements to select a layout that fits the road, the work and the people moving through the area. Coordinate any required approvals before work begins.
* **Lead field implementation of traffic control plans.** Brief forepersons and traffic control personnel, verify that signs, devices, lane closures and pedestrian routes match the plan, and inspect the setup as work progresses. Update the plan and brief the crew again when the work area or traffic conditions change.
* Work with our locate coordinator and forepersons to verify that complete, valid locate packages are on site before digging, cover the actual work area and agree with field markings. If information is missing or unclear, make sure the affected work pauses until it’s resolved.
* Review hazards around excavation, trenching, directional drilling and heavy equipment. Lead toolbox talks, investigate incidents and near misses, and turn findings into practical changes.
* Write and update company policies, safe work procedures and field forms. Help supervisors roll them out and get feedback from the crews using them.
* Support HR administration through employee onboarding, training records, certification renewals and policy acknowledgements. Handle employee information with discretion.
* Help project managers verify crew assignments and job progress. Compare site observations, daily reports and submitted hours, then follow up with forepersons on discrepancies before payroll and job costing are finalized.
* Use Microsoft 365, digital forms and AI tools to cut duplicate paperwork and make records easier to use. Review AI-assisted work for accuracy and protect confidential information.

**What you’ll bring**

* Hands-on construction safety experience and a working knowledge of Ontario’s *Occupational Health and Safety Act* and the Construction Projects regulation. Experience in heavy civil, underground utilities, telecom or trenchless construction is especially valuable.
* Practical knowledge of Ontario Traffic Manual Book 7 and experience preparing traffic control plans, explaining them to crews and checking that the layout works safely in the field.
* The judgment to stop and question unsafe work, the communication skills to explain why, and the ability to earn a crew’s trust.
* Strong computer skills, clear writing and the initiative to improve a process when you see a better way.
* The ability to travel regularly to job sites across Southwestern Ontario.

**About The Rounds:**  
The Rounds is a Health Care Professionals (HCPs) collaboration platform, a dynamic and fast-moving health technology company. The Rounds connects HCPs across Canada, enabling meaningful peer engagement, medical education, and life sciences partnerships that improve patient outcomes.
  
  
**About this Opportunity:**  
The Customer Experience Manager builds and strengthens relationships with The Rounds’ clients and association partners across its HCP networks, delivering a consistent, high-quality experience from sales handoff and onboarding through campaign delivery, reporting, and renewal.
  
Working closely with Sales, Community, and Product, the role translates client objectives into well-executed programs, including sponsored content, digital advertising, and medical education events such as Pro Webinars, Ask-the-Expert Forums, and Pulse Points Video Series. This includes supporting HCP speakers through platform onboarding, preparation, and participation.
  
  
**Job Functions:**  
Client Relationships and Experience
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients and association partners, building lasting relationships through responsive service and proactive communication.
* Lead client onboarding and campaign kickoffs, confirming objectives, audiences, deliverables, timelines, and reporting expectations.
* Maintain regular client touchpoints, anticipate needs, resolve concerns, and coordinate internal support to ensure timely follow-through.
* Gather client and speaker feedback and recommend improvements to processes, products, and services.

Campaign Planning and Delivery
  

* Manage campaign delivery according to client agreements, objectives, and approved scope, translating requirements into clear project plans across internal teams.
* Guide clients through asset requirements and timelines, then set up and launch campaigns on the platform in line with approved assets and agreements.
* Lead HCP speaker onboarding and preparation for medical education events, including account setup, platform orientation, materials, and technical checks, with clear communication throughout.
* Monitor milestones and deliverables, identify risks early, and communicate adjustments to stakeholders.
* Recommend content formats, promotional approaches, and refinements that support HCP reach and engagement.

Reporting, Insights, and Account Growth
  

* Track performance against agreed objectives and forecasts, including reach, impressions, engagements, frequency, and content or video metrics, and coordinate optimizations throughout the campaign.
* Prepare accurate, timely reports that translate results into clear insights and practical recommendations.
* Maintain visibility into account health, client satisfaction, campaign end dates, and renewal opportunities.
* Collaborate with Sales on renewals and account growth, recommending complementary offerings and new platform features based on client needs and results.

Compliance and Administration
  

* Coordinate required content reviews and approvals in line with advertising standards, client requirements, and internal policies, including PAAB where applicable.
* Monitor and coordinate adverse event reporting for sponsored content according to established procedures and timelines.
* Maintain accurate campaign, client, and speaker records in HubSpot and designated project management systems.
* Track launches and billing milestones and notify Finance promptly to support accurate invoicing and revenue recognition.

**Other Responsibilities and Capabilities:**  

* Maintain working knowledge of The Rounds’ platforms, audiences, products, and services, and bring client and speaker perspective to product testing and feedback.
* Contribute to Customer Experience processes, templates, and SOPs, including speaker onboarding and event implementation.
* Bring sound judgment, strong organization, and excellent written and verbal communication to managing multiple campaigns and competing priorities.
* Apply analytical thinking and practical problem-solving to campaign performance, client concerns, and operational challenges.

* Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns or projects end to end, coordinating timelines, approvals, and cross-functional teams.

You will take a leading role in managing multidisciplinary design teams, ensuring technical quality and coordinating interfaces across structures, highways, geotechnical, utilities, drainage and other disciplines. * Lead or oversee structural analysis, design development, design verification and technical reviews.
* Review and approve engineering calculations, design reports, drawings, specifications and other technical deliverables.
* Provide technical direction on complex engineering challenges relating to bridge structures, underground structures and transportation infrastructure.
* Ensure designs are developed in accordance with applicable Saudi Arabian requirements and recognised international design standards and codes.
* Lead technical reviews, value engineering exercises, constructability assessments and design optimisation.

* Promote innovative and sustainable design solutions, including consideration of whole-life performance, durability, maintainability and embodied carbon.

* Monitor project progress against programme, budget and agreed scope.

* Coordinate with Project Directors, Project Managers and Design Managers to ensure successful delivery.
* Take ownership of technical risks within the Bridges & Tunnels discipline and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are implemented.

* Encourage knowledge sharing, innovation and consistent application of engineering best practice.

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions. Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

* Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator)
